summary: Candidate is a distinct knowledge_reference skill for Spring Boot 3.0 instrumentation deprecation mapping. It differs semantically from peer candidates (dependency management lookup, custom observation convention migration, deprecation removal validation) by focusing specifically on deprecated instrumentation class-to-Observation replacement mappings. No existing skill in the registry covers this specific deprecation reference domain. Peer candidates address related but separate concerns: dependency changes, custom convention implementation, and general deprecation scanning. The candidate has explicit support evidence from Spring Boot 3.0 Migration Guide and fills a planning-stage reference gap for metrics instrumentation migration.
